stock.description: Times Universal Group Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, with its primary operations centered on hotel management within the People's Republic of China and Canada. Beyond its core hospitality business, the group also delivers property management services and holds a collection of investment properties to generate rental income. The firm, which was previously known as Forebase International Holdings Limited, rebranded to Times Universal Group Holdings Limited in July 2020. Established in 1987, its corporate headquarters are situated in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
